problem: Operator, 29 Oct 2026: 'mission planner is configures t[o] have se[r]vo til[t] on channel 8, the pi is making it tilt on channel 6 as well fix that and fix the issue where the dc motor stops spinning even though the channel 6 is up or down'.

found.camera: venue.yaml camera_ctrl rc_tilt_channel 6 (0c241e1): with no mission running the Pi sent channel 6's pulse to SERVO5 with DO_SET_SERVO, so the winch switch tilted the camera. The FC (live read, 29 Oct 02:48): SERVO5_FUNCTION 58 (RC8 passthrough, set by the operator in Mission Planner), SERVO5_MIN/MAX 1100/1900, RC8_DZ 0, RC8_OPTION 0, RC6_OPTION 0.
found.ardupilot_passthrough: ArduPilot master AP_ServoRelayEvents::do_set_servo accepts k_rcin1..16 outputs, sets the pulse and calls ignore_small_rcin_changes(); SRV_Channel::output_ch then keeps it until the RC input differs by more than the channel's dead zone. So with SERVO5_FUNCTION 58 a Pi pose holds only while channel 8 stays still; RC8_DZ 0 hands the servo back on any change.
found.winch: winch_ctrl dropped RC6 hand drive when /aerothon/rc/in was older than rc_timeout_s (0.5 s) and reset rc_ready, so it stayed stopped with the switch held until the switch was seen in the middle. The channels come from the FC's RC_CHANNELS, requested at 5 Hz by stream_rate_keeper, over the 115200 TELEM link, then rc_in_bridge: two late messages were enough. Until ~01:00 29 Oct the FC also forwarded the ELRS port's ~100/s RC overrides onto that link (osd_elrs_20261029 set MAV2_OPTIONS 2). Measured 29 Oct with the transmitter off: router 76 RC_CHANNELS in 15 s, worst gap 0.251 s; /aerothon/rc/in 97 in 20 s, worst gap 0.385 s. The L298N driver has no run-time limit; no winch limits are saved on the Pi. The winch did not log hand drive stops, so the observed stop is not attributed from logs.
